Title: Ashur tablet bringing the dead back to hand

Messages.Author: Jesper
Messages.Body:
What happens if I play the 3. Ashur tablets and takes a crypt card in hand?

If its an imbued, can I use piper to recruit him?

----References----
Ashur tablets
Master
Put this card in play. If you have three copies in play, remove all copies in play (even controlled by other Methuselahs) from the game to gain 3 pool and choose up to thirteen cards from your ash heap. Move one of those cards to your hand and shuffle the others into your library.

Piper
Master. Requires a ready anarch.
A ready untapped anarch you control employs or recruits a retainer or ally from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is not an action and cannot be blocked. Tap that anarch.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
You can't move crypt cards to your hand.

groups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/vtes-rules/conversations/topics/233

> LSJ wrote:
> Bartłomiej veyDer Rudzki wrote:
> > What happens if I have an Imbued in my ash heap and I play the
> > outferior Resurrection on him? Is it placed in my hand? Can I recruit
> > him with my minions?
>
> You can't move him to your hand.
>
> Even though he is an ally, crypt cards cannot be placed into your hand (nor into
> your library).
>
> The only things that can hold both crypt and library cards are the controlled
> and uncontrolled regions (and the "out of play" region, if you want to get nuts
> about it).
>
There must also be a reference somewhere in the rules or rulings.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
